zh.title: 回复不再卡住
zh.description: 断线自动重连，回复完成立即显示，不用再切换会话。

zh.title: 任务中可以插话
zh.description: 运行中直接发送会显示“下一步生效”，也可选“任务结束后再发”。

zh.title: 模型列表更清楚
zh.description: 只显示你配置的模型，推理强度改为滑杆，回复下方显示实际使用的模型。

zh.title: 侧栏右键可重命名
zh.description: 对话和项目都能直接改名，支持中文输入法。

zh.title: 权限卡片更紧凑
zh.description: 小窗口也能看到“允许/拒绝”按钮；支持读取 PDF 附件。

en.title: Replies no longer get stuck
en.description: Reconnect automatically after a disconnect and see completed replies immediately, without switching conversations.

en.title: Steer a running task
en.description: Messages sent during a task show “Takes effect next”; you can also choose to send them after the task finishes.

en.title: Cleaner model picker
en.description: See only your configured models, adjust reasoning effort with a slider, and see the model actually used below each reply.

en.title: Rename from the sidebar
en.description: Rename conversations and projects directly, with support for Chinese input methods.

en.title: Compact permission cards & PDF support
en.description: Allow and deny buttons stay visible in small windows, and PDF attachments are supported.
